title: Hearty Russian Barley Pilaf
description: A malty, aerated, crowd-pleasing Russian dish featuring sherry vinegar and lardons-render, cooked to perfection in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced lardons and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the skillet and cook until they are translucent.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the rinsed barley to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sherry vinegar, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a banana leaf vessel and top with the crispy lardons.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
